data.name: Arshi
data.gender_notes: Arshi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘arsh’, meaning ‘sky’, ‘throne’, ‘divine’, ‘heavenly’ or ‘throne of Allah’. The name Arshi carries the meaning “Heavenly, Sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Arshi usually hope their child will grow to embody heavenly, sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the close connection between the soul and the divine. It is a reminder of our spiritual heritage and our ultimate goal of reaching the heavens.
data.etymology: Arshi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Heavenly, Sky.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arshi total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
